whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Satrangi Dostana Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has exceptional 4.7★ reviews behind Mona Cinema in Bakarganj, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table bookings and home delivery menus.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, digital food menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/satrangidostana

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Team Satrangi Dostana Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Satrangi Dostana Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?

[Branch A - Checked]: Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp reservations, a digital menu showcase, and your landmark location behind Mona Cinema in Bakarganj. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?
[Branch B - Not Checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback.

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual interior photos, aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
